recommended_contingency_crops.name: Pearl Millet (Bajra - ICTP 8203 / Dhanashakti)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: High drought tolerance, matures in 75-80 days, minimal water requirement during vegetative phase.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Pigeonpea / Red Gram (Arhar - BDN 711 / BSMR 736)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Deep taproot system recovers after dry spells; intercropped with soybean/pearl millet.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Castor (DCH-177 / DCH-519)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Excellent resilience to delayed rains in shallow red soils.

agronomic_measures: Widen inter-row spacing to 45cm, apply straw mulch @ 5 t/ha, foliar spray of 2% Urea or 1% KNO3 during moisture stress.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Early maturing Soybean (JS 9560 / JS 20-34)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Short duration ensures harvest before terminal moisture stress in deep black soils.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Green Gram / Black Gram (Moong / Urad - BM 2003-2)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Very short 60-65 day cycle captures residual moisture.

agronomic_measures: Broad Bed and Furrow (BBF) planting to conserve in-situ rainwater.

onset_delay_condition: >15 days delay or prolonged dry spell (>14 CDD)

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Short Duration Paddy (Sahbhagi Dhan / Khandagiri / Mandakini)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: High drought tolerance at flowering stage, escapes terminal moisture stress in upland red soils.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Blackgram / Greengram (Urad PU-31 / Moong IPM 02-14)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Short duration pulse contingency requiring 60% less water than transplanted rice.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Submergence-Tolerant Paddy (Swarna-Sub1 / CR Dhan 801)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Sub1 gene provides up to 14 days total submergence tolerance in high flood risk riverine blocks (Bonaigarh, Koida, Lahunipada).

agronomic_measures: Adopt Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) with seed priming (soaking in 1% KCl for 12 hrs), apply straw mulch @ 4 t/ha, life-saving irrigation from farm ponds.
